bibliographic.title: All Tomorrow's Parties
bibliographic.author: Niamh Schönherr
bibliographic.description: Created specifically for anyone who may be questioning and struggling, "All Tomorrow's Parties" is an autobiographical game about the early stages of investigating and questioning one's own gender. Similar to the more recent #eggmode hashtag, the game revisits memories and tries to make sense of them through the interpretive lens of the present, while also challenging the power of memory by asserting the unconditional validity of the present.
